name: Sugar mills and cotton ginning

problems.words: Trolleys queue for two days at the cane yard and growers are furious
quick_ideas: Note arrival and weighment times for a day, so you see where the longest wait is
Give each trolley a numbered token at arrival.

workzap_build.text: a yard token that would send each trolley a WhatsApp message with its queue position and expected weighment time.

problems.ask_first: Where does the longest wait happen today?
problems.free_stops: How tokens and timing are managed goes in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare how long trolleys wait at unloading, weighment and yard entry for one busy day, so the true choke point is clear.
Give one yard clerk the job of keeping a single arrival line on paper, so trolley movement follows one order all day.

problems.words: Growers say our weighbridge cheats them
quick_ideas: Give every grower their weight and deductions in writing at weighment, so trust starts with a record
Let growers see the scale reading.

workzap_build.text: A weighment record that sends each grower their weights and deductions by WhatsApp instantly, with their permission.

problems.ask_first: How do growers see their weights now?
problems.free_stops: How weighment messages are generated is part of the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note how many weight disputes happen on each shift this week, so you see when mistrust rises most.
Give one weighbridge person the job of showing and noting each final reading, so fewer loads turn into arguments at the bridge.

problems.words: CPR records and payment records are kept separately and don't match
quick_ideas: Match one week of CPRs to payments by hand, so you see the size of the gap
Use the same grower code in both records.

workzap_build.text: CPR-to-payment reconciliation connecting weighment and accounts, with outstanding by grower code and centre.

problems.ask_first: Where are CPRs and payments kept?
problems.free_stops: How the two places connect is detailed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare one day's CPR entries with the same day's payment entries line by line, so the mismatch pattern is obvious.
Give one clerk one master register for CPR reference beside payment posting, so both records follow the same source each day.

problems.words: Purchase centre staff are taking money from growers to jump the queue
quick_ideas: Make queue order visible to growers, so jumping the line is noticed
Give growers a channel to report concerns to head office.

workzap_build.text: a purchase centre summary showing arrivals, weights, queue order and issues reported at every centre.

problems.ask_first: How many purchase centres do you run?
problems.free_stops: What is tracked overall is kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many queue order complaints come from each purchase centre this week, so you see where control is weakest.
Give one head office caller the job of checking the first and last trolley served daily, so queue order gets watched routinely.

problems.words: Mill stopped for a day in peak crushing because of a breakdown
quick_ideas: Record every stoppage with section, cause and duration, so repeat causes are visible
Review the list with section heads weekly.

workzap_build.text: A downtime log by section and cause, with the season's total visible to management daily.

problems.free_stops: The downtime log design goes in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note which section causes the longest unplanned stop during each shift this week, so repeat breakdown trouble stands out fast.
Give one shift engineer one stoppage log kept in the control room, so every breakdown gets handed over with the cause noted.

problems.words: Molasses sales record is loose, tankers go out without a clear count
quick_ideas: Weigh every tanker in and out and keep the slip, so each load has a figure
Release tankers only against a gate pass.

workzap_build.text: A tanker dispatch log with weights in and out and gate passes, flagging gaps.

problems.free_stops: How tanker records are matched is part of the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count tanker exits against the day's molasses dispatch notes for one week, so missing load records show up quickly.
Give one gate person one dispatch notebook for every tanker leaving, so outbound loads are counted from one place each day.

problems.words: Spinning mills pay for lint months later
quick_ideas: List every buyer's balance by age, so follow-up is in order
Assign one person to follow up weekly.

workzap_build.text: A buyer lifting and receivables tracker with ageing and reminders.

problems.ask_first: How long do buyers usually take to pay?
problems.free_stops: Reminder rules are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare which buyers pay latest against the dates goods left the gate, so slow accounts stop blending into the rest.
Give one office person a fixed weekly calling hour for overdue buyers, so follow up happens regularly before balances age further.

problems.words: Phutti quality varies and trash deductions cause arguments
quick_ideas: Record each trash and moisture deduction in writing with a photo, so the decision is visible
Share it with the supplier at the time.

workzap_build.text: A phutti intake log with moisture and trash deductions recorded with photos and shared with the supplier.

problems.free_stops: How deductions are recorded and shared goes in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note which purchase point creates the most trash deduction arguments this week, so you know where checking is least consistent.
Give one grader one deductions register kept at the buying table, so every quality call is written in the same place immediately.

problems.words: Board wants daily crushing reports, we compile them by hand
quick_ideas: Fix one report format and the time it goes out, so it isn't rebuilt daily
Note which figures take longest to gather.

workzap_build.text: A daily crushing or ginning report sent directly to owners and the board.

problems.ask_first: How long does the report take now?
problems.free_stops: Report contents and data sources are kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count which daily crushing figures arrive last each evening, so you know exactly what delays the board report.
Give one office person the job of collecting all section figures at one fixed time, so report making stops drifting across the night.

problems.words: Seasonal staff need training every year from scratch
quick_ideas: Write down the five things every new seasonal person must know, so training is consistent
Ask experienced staff what new people get wrong most.

workzap_build.text: A seasonal onboarding checklist with a short training pack on phone and supervisor sign-off.

problems.ask_first: How many people do you add each season?
problems.free_stops: The onboarding content and flow are detailed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count the mistakes new seasonal staff repeat most during one shift, so this year's training covers the weak spots sooner.
Give one supervisor a notebook for starter points at shift change, so each batch learns the same essentials every season.

never_say: Advice on cane support prices, cane laws, grower payment obligations, sugar pricing, export or import policy.
Advice on cotton grading standards, factory safety engineering, environmental or effluent rules, tax or credit.
Any help manipulating weighbridges, under-recording cane, issuing fake CPRs, hoarding, mis-declaring stock or evading sales tax.
Comment on politically sensitive topics such as sugar prices or government action.
Storing growers', middlemen's, buyers' or workers' names, CNICs, bank details or numbers.

sample_reply.person: Rahim Yar Khan mein ginning factory hai. Phutti waale trash ki katauti pe har dafa larte hain, koi hal batao.
sample_reply.pi:
Bilkul, is ka hal mumkin hai, aur is ke liye bade kharch ki zaroorat nahi.
Pehle, har gaari ki trash aur nami ki katauti photo ke saath likh kar usi waqt supplier ko dikha dein, taake faisla saaf nazar aaye.
Doosra, katauti ka tareeqa supplier ke saath pehle se tay kar ke likh lein.
Workzap is se aage ye kar sakta hai: har gaari ki aamad, wazan aur katauti photo ke saath darj ho aur supplier ko foran WhatsApp pe pohanch jaaye.

Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
